audit.method: Compare original excerpts, origin text and result quotations with the public JSON/RDF after normalizing whitespace and case; minimum 45 characters. Additional 90-character fragment search for interview and ABNT source quotations.

limits: A bounded string comparison is not proof that every possible fragment or identifying inference is absent.
Authored research statements and bibliographic references remain public.
Third-party software has its own preserved licenses; original research has no open reuse license in this release.
Do not supply identifiable cases to the public demonstrator.
